correctness.rationale: N_lambda has polytope unit ball with 8 vertices obtained by signed permutations of (1,a), a=lambda^−1−1 in [0,1]. The arithmetic endpoint (||x+y||+||x−y||)/2 is convex on the product ball, so its maximum is attained on vertex pairs. Symmetry reduces to four orbit values 1, 2lambda, 1/lambda, max(1/lambda,2lambda); the explicit pair (1,a),(-a,1) has both chord norms equal m=max(1/lambda,2lambda). Scalar Heinz ≤ arithmetic mean gives H_nu≤m and equality for this pair gives >=m uniformly 0<=nu<=1. Monotonic branches intersect only at lambda=1/sqrt(2), min sqrt(2); degenerate boundary lambda=1/2,1 checked. Independent exhaustive 64-vertex-pair evaluations at representative lambdas are corroborative; vertex reduction is proof.
